findings.finding: The target selection and post-reload state checks are well scoped, but a stale refusal alert is not excluded before the operator step. Since success only checks that the alert is present afterward, a prior alert could satisfy this part of the oracle if the expected denial never happened and ACK were supplied.
findings.evidence: tests/browser/isolated-permission-denial-acceptance.mjs: state() reports refusal_alert; the before assertion checks admin/declared/row_count/switch_on/contains/get_all but omits refusal_alert; the after predicate requires refusal_alert.
findings.recommendation: Clear or explicitly assert absence of the refusal alert before the request boundary, then require it after the boundary. Keep ACK described and treated as coordination only; retain independent native UI evidence as the proof of the human action.
